title: The normalized derived evaluation adjunction
statement: For J,O,ell and strict coefficient systems as above [lem-pur-coefficient-evaluation-strict-extension], fix the additive ordinary extensions E_n, evaluations e_n, their adjunctions and their below/above tensor formulas. Choose arbitrary unbounded derived localizations of the level and system categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Then the termwise E_n followed by localization has a pointwise universal left derived functor LE_n whose comparison is invertible on every K-flat complex [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Exact evaluation descends termwise and LE_n is left adjoint to this derived evaluation. The derived Hom equivalence on every chain-map representative agrees with the given ordinary complex adjunction followed by the inverse exact-evaluation comparison.

source.place: Construction 4.1, printed p. 21: the functors e_n! and (Le_n!, e_n^-1), with indices shifted from n >= 0 to n >= 1. The natural sigma maps are the truncation inclusions in its explicit formula; the Hom identity specifies their adjunction mates.

proof.text: A system morphism with invertible level components has the componentwise inverse; the transition squares follow by canceling its components. Exact evaluation commutes with homology, so these evaluations jointly detect quasi-isomorphisms of system complexes.

For a map of K-flat complexes, below n use the ordinary tensor comparison and preservation of quasi-isomorphisms by quotient scalar extension; above n the terms are zero and the component chain map is invertible. Therefore E_n preserves these quasi-isomorphisms.

Choose K-flat resolutions and apply the normalized resolving-class adjunction theorem to each E_n adjoint to e_n. Retain its pointwise existence, universal comparison, K-flat computation and normalized transpose on every representative.
